- Comparison notes: see the Comparison notes section below. The Gift stage step and training match the demo as in the earlier review; the sheet shows the owner a Fighting style block beside the Gift with the style's name, defense tag, description, Tradition, Attacks, Defends and Vows rows and the style skill's value, in the demo's words, and shows a stranger nothing; the block now carries the Tradition and Vows rows that demo screen 6's style card draws (the vows ruling covers creation only, and the creation step still carries no vow)
- Tested interactions: recorded through the CG API a draft in a Tradition (Masque) teaching three styles, the style options endpoint, the draft before and after picking The Daring Dance (draft PATCH selected_combat_style_id), the training pool before and after the pick, spending the pool on the style skill (20) and another skill (10), an attempt to spend on another style's skill (refused with Magic skills only), switching to a Tradition that teaches none (style and its allocation cleared), finalize through add-to-roster (sheet combat_style and both skill stores), a Tradition teaching none end to end; gave the finalized character to a player (a tenure, arranged as the journey does) and read the sheet payload as that owner and as a stranger; rendered the real Gift stage from the recorded payloads and clicked a style entry open and clicked Select on The Daring Dance (the page sent PATCH selected_combat_style_id and moved to the training step); rendered the real character sheet for the owner and for the stranger; asked the Sphinx about a vow the style lists, one it does not, and as a character with no style, over REST and the telnet verb, and as the character the CG journey itself finalized
- Fixture/live boundary: live code paths (the CG draft, select-tradition, combat-styles and add-to-roster services, serializers and validators, the character sheet serializer and its privileged gate, the Sphinx judge_vow with its REST serializer and telnet renderer, the real React components); fixtures are factory-built (Masque with The Daring Dance, Veil and Needle and The Iron Mask carrying the demo's names, descriptions, defense styles, armor shares and hit stats; their gear rows and listed vows; a Tradition Training distinction giving 20 points arranged straight into draft_data as the journeys do, because the real route needs a distinction offer; skills Occult, Thaumaturgy and one skill per style; the Gift and Resonance carry factory names Style CG Gift and Resonance0; the owner's tenure on the finalized character is arranged with RosterTenureFactory as the committed journey does; Sphinx vows Quicksilver and Bulwark with no demands so every verdict is the takes tier); the browser was fed the recorded real payloads by Playwright route interception (seven states, browser-feed-*.json), the draft PATCH was answered with the payload the real server returned for that same PATCH rather than running the server during the click, the arranged training entry was given empty offer_ids, sources and arrivals by the harness, and the page-chrome endpoints (inbox, ceremonies, consent, makeover) were answered with empty lists; the sheet page shows the front only (no art, no appearance, no worship data beyond the recorded payload), and the stranger's vitals request is the real 404; no real account, no live game server
- Overall outcome: PASS

Differences, all explained: the Vows row is absent by the owner ruling; the weapon and armor wording is the server's gear labels (one-handed melee, thrown, light armor, robe) where the demo wrote example phrases (one-handed blades, thrown knives, clothing), and clothing cannot be a style gear kind; the shield on The Iron Mask appears under Defends as well as Attacks because shield is both a weapon and an armor kind; cards are in name order; the chosen style is shown by the funnel's Select mark and by the collapsed step's value instead of the demo's Chosen button; the tag sits under the name as in every funnel Entry.
